judgment_calls.topic: Sex-specific window for recent sexual assault
judgment_calls.decision: Sex checked for as SNOMED findings Female/Male, each paired with its own onset window (5 days / 3 days).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Use 5 days for everyone (over-fires for men on days 4-5), or 3 days for everyone (misses women on days 4-5). The language has no patient-sex predicate; if Female/Male is not recorded, this branch never fires.

judgment_calls.decision: Physical and emotional abuse rules require the abuse context (Victim of abuse or Victim of psychological trauma), because the page only applies them to the traumatised/abused patient; scars, anxiety or withdrawal alone would otherwise diagnose abuse in any patient.
